name: Duty's Soulshackle (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor

stealth.details: (expert); noticing the staff has a DC of 0.

disable: DC 23 Arcana check, DC 23 Occultism check, or DC 23 Religion check (trained) to disrupt the spectral energies channeled by the intelligent item. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one. When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled.
routine: (three actions) On its initiative, Duty's Soulshackle first uses Call to Serve if it's able to and spends any remaining actions making velstrac chains Strikes against its enemies.

items.name: Chained by Duty
items.text:
Trigger Lyari proposes how to free herself from Duty's Soulshackle.

---
Effect Duty's Soulshackle quivers in rage before unleashing more spectral chains. The haunt then rolls initiative.

items.name: Call to Serve
items.text: Duty's Soulshackle creates a Shriveled Leaf of Talhindir within 10 feet of itself. It then cannot use this action for 1d6 rounds.

text: A length of humanoid spine is held into a staff by the hooked chain embedded in and entwined around it. Additional spectral chains of pure shadowstuff hold it aloft and sinuously surround it.
